question: Should OpenClaw move memory ownership from one exclusive `plugins.slots.memory` selector to role-specific global and per-agent memory slots, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the candidate implementation path?
rationale: The request changes public config and plugin runtime semantics, and VISION.md currently describes memory as one special slot while also allowing plugin API extension discussions when current seams are insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor role slots
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation candidate after conflict, upgrade, and compatibility review.

options.title: Narrow first
options.body: Ask for a smaller plugin API or doctor/diagnostic change that solves the most painful coexistence case before adding a full role taxonomy.

options.title: Decline architecture
options.body: Keep memory as one recommended slot and route additional memory behaviors to external plugins or sidecar workflows.

recommendation.title: Sponsor role slots
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the implementation candidate after conflict, upgrade, and compatibility review.
